Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across every job.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Requires MogVault for current-character relic detection and material counts across bags, retainers, dresser, and armoire (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync covers relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- RelicTracker opens on All Relics, with every weapon, tool, and armor series in one place.
- Pick any upgrade to see a short plan and expand Quest details for the full walkthrough. Armor pages show missing pieces by role or job.
- Materials follows the series you open and groups what's left by how you get it. One-time unlocks have their own section.
- Save Knightshopper lists for eligible materials, missing Dawntrail armor pieces, and supported armor upgrade materials.
- MogVault is required for Materials and live inventory tracking. Existing completion marks still count, and FFXIV Collect can track relics you no longer own.
- Augmented Law's Order and Augmented Bozjan armor now show the right costs, counted per slot.
- Materials lists all 12 Atma one by one, each with the zone its FATEs are in.
- Craft with Artisan no longer starts the wrong list on Zodiac and Shadowbringers weapon steps.
- Corrected material amounts for Crystalline, Chora-Zoi's and Brilliant Alchemist and Culinarian tools.
- Lucis tools now ask for 5 of each crafter's class item, and the Vrandtic and Lodestar fishing steps ask for one fish instead of two.
- Corrected several upgrade guides: Zodiac turn-in order, the Blade's and Manderville unlock quests, Eclipticum no longer saying North Horn is required, Skysteel turn-in NPCs, and the Elemental armor vendor.
- Materials you already crafted into a turn-in no longer show as still needed, and Knightshopper lists skip armor you can exchange or already bought.
- Relics kept only as replicas, such as Replica of the Omnilex, now count.
- FFXIV Collect progress now counts on armor pieces and earlier weapon steps, and Cosmic tool stages no longer drop after relogging.
- FFXIV Collect is now linked per character, so your alts no longer show your main's relics. Your existing link moves to the first character you log in with; link other characters in Setup.
- Setup can clear old hand-made marks from version 1 (hold Ctrl and click).
